summary: Require the actual Rat Ear Pie rather than its recipe book, and restore Caninel’s documented completion lore.

evidence.note: Cached 2026-07-17T23:28:12.127Z; revision unavailable; SHA256 cedda62b7e870dd85922c151b294cd4e102b31cf15d5188a557ec4e0f5548fea. Remove only recipe-book alternative; valid food exchange and safe surplus return remain. Caninel three gems10019/10070/10021 unchanged. before.name: Vin_Moltor
before.lua_content:
-- Converted from ProjectEQ Perl quest script.
-- Source: qcat/Vin_Moltor.pl
-- items: 13016, 13192, 17014, 18103

function event_say(e)
	if e.message:findi("hail") then
		e.self:Say("Heh?? .. BURRP!.. Leave me be will ya.")
	elseif e.message:findi("paw of opolla") then
		e.self:Say("Paw ya say? Yeah.. Yeah .. I got this ratty old thing still. You want it? Its yours for a Bottle of Kalish and hm.. .. How bad you want it?  Hm..  Two..  No no..  Three Gold..  Er..  NO! Wait. Pie..  Yes! Rat Ear Pie is what I want.. Three Bottles of Kalish and a Rat Eat Pie. If you want the Paw that is my price.")
	end
end

function event_trade(e)
	local item_lib = require("items")
	if item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 13016, item2 = 13016, item3 = 13016, item4 = 13192}) or item_lib.check_turn_in(e.trade, {item1 = 13016, item2 = 13016, item3 = 13016, item4 = 18103}) then
		e.self:Say("Ah thanks, here is what I promised you.")
		e.other:SummonItem(17014)
	end
	item_lib.return_items(e.self, e.other, e.trade)
end
